stem: After a test ends, an analyst chooses as guardrails the metrics that happened not to get worse. What is the problem?

options.text: None, as long as at least three guardrails are reported with the result
Guardrails should be chosen from the metrics that improved the most
Guardrails chosen after the results can hide harm; they belong in the plan
Guardrails must always be the same metric as the test's success metric
